risks.title: Generation tie line may not be creditable energy property
risks.detail: The cost segregation report includes $5,600,000 of project-owned interconnection facilities in eligible basis, covering the generation tie and the project substation. A generation tie line is generally treated as transmission equipment rather than energy property. Interconnection property is creditable only for small facilities, and this is a 100 MWac project. If the gen-tie portion is disallowed, eligible basis and the $71,000,000 credit would fall by 50% of the disallowed amount. The eligible-basis figure itself matches the term sheet exactly.

evidence.text: facilities are owned by the Project and are energy property of the taxpayer
